title: Product-graph comparisons intertwine proper/open interchange between presentations
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. Work on the ordinary unbounded small-etale categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with $R_v=Rv_*$ and $J_j=Dj_!$ [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-exact]. A presentation $(a,e,p)$ of a scheme map is a factorization as proper $a$, open $e$, proper $p$, with functor $F_{(a,e,p)}=R_pJ_eR_a$ [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-open-immersion]. For presentations of a fixed map admitting an open-then-proper factorization, use exactly the product-graph comparisons $C_{t,s}:F_s\xrightarrow{\sim}F_t$ of [lem-pur-etale-graph-comparison-base-change]. Use the normalized proper/open interchange $\Gamma$ of [lem-pur-etale-proper-open-exchange-cube].

First, let $a:X	o O$ and $a':X	o W$ be proper, $u:W\hookrightarrow O$ and $e:O\hookrightarrow P$ open, and $p:P	o Z$ proper, with $ua'=a$. Suppose $pea$ admits an open-then-proper factorization. Let $H=(a,e,p)$ and $S=(a',eu,p)$. For the commutative proper/open square $Q_u$ with top $1_X$, bottom $u$, left $a'$ and right $a$, one has
$$C_{S,H}=R_pJ_e(\Gamma_{Q_u}^{-1}):R_pJ_eR_a\longrightarrow R_pJ_eJ_uR_{a'}\cong F_S.$$

Then, as natural transformations $F_{d_1}F_{t_1}	o F_{s_2}$,
$$C_{s_2,s_1}\circ I_1=I_2\circ(C_{d_2,d_1}F_{t_2})\circ F_{d_1}(C_{t_2,t_1}).$$
All formulas insert the canonical proper direct-image and open-extension compositors [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition, lem-cbc-extension-zero-composition]. The $C$ are the specified graph maps, not merely isomorphisms with those endpoints. The two squares $Q_

proof.text: The graph comparison from the auxiliary compactification is Side1 followed by Middle followed by Side2 inverse. The side-pasting and intersection-pasting equations imply B_S = B_H followed by the specified shrinking word, by cancellation of the neighborhood triangle and side factors. Cancel B_H inverse in C_HS to obtain the first assertion.

Apply the pairwise normalization to source, middle and composite presentations. Apply the selected-row equation for each index, with the same explicit productInterchange U. Cancel the second composite lambda on the right and substitute the two row equations. Naturality moves the second source lambda through the two middle lambdas. Their inverses cancel. This gives precisely the three pairwise comparison factors of the required second assertion.
